title: A dual system piezoelectric energy harvester for harvesting low frequency ocean energy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4902-4912
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00409H, Paper
Chensheng Wang, Xuesen Yuan, Luyang Tan, Zhenheng Li, Shuangjian Wang, Lipeng He
A dual system hybrid piezoelectric energy harvester (DS-PEH) for harvesting ocean energy is proposed. The lever module can amplify the external load and the dual system hybrid power generation is adopted. The DS-PEH can power low-power sensors.
